verdict.rationale: Jan documents model management on its settings page: importing GGUF files and searching Hugging Face IDs in the Hub, plus pause/resume for downloads. Custom assistants with saved instructions roughly stand in for saved prompts. Per-model configuration and a single unified management view are not evidenced. missing for 10: per-model configuration settings (parameters, context, etc.), evidence of a unified place managing models, prompts and configs together, a dedicated saved-prompt library, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place

citations.quote: From Local Files: Click Import Model and select your GGUF files.
Enter a model's Hugging Face ID (e.g., `org/model_name_or_id`) in the Hub's search bar.
you can assign an assistant to it so every conversation in that project automatically uses your chosen persona and instructions.
